com.empline/tool-documentation.access: Requires OAuth store:prices:write consent. Write consent is required because this preparation issues price-update approvals. The connected account must own an approved store.
com.empline/tool-documentation.effects: Read-only; issuing approvals does not apply prices or enable automation.
com.empline/tool-documentation.failures: Invalid selections or a missing approved store are refused; unsuitable guidance, holds and sale prices produce skipped rows.
com.empline/tool-documentation.notFor: Recurring pricing, inventory quantities and listing publication are outside this proposal.
com.empline/tool-documentation.purpose: Prepare exact one-time card price changes for explicit user confirmation.
com.empline/tool-documentation.returns: Returns old/proposed prices and signed tokens for eligible rows, skipped reasons and nextCursor; tokens expire after ten minutes.
com.empline/tool-documentation.useWhen: Use when the user intends to review specific prices before an in-chat update; an omitted strategy uses the store setting.

cardType.description: Review RAW, graded/authenticated, or all active in-stock card copies in the connected store.

cursor.description: Continue with nextCursor from the previous page, keeping the same selection.

direction.description: Filter one-time price changes. Ongoing repricing requires ANY; publishing includes all displayed cards.

strategy.description: AT_MARKET, PREMIUM (above market), or MOVE_FAST. Omit to use the existing store strategy. Confirmed automation uses this as store-wide strategy.
